description: This Java source file defines the ExternalDictionaryFactory class, which manages external dictionary add-ons for an Android keyboard application. It handles loading, enabling/disabling, and retrieving dictionary add-ons based on locale or ID, and provides methods for associating dictionaries with specific keyboards.

classes.name: ExternalDictionaryFactory
classes.description: A factory class for managing external dictionary add-ons, including loading, enabling/disabling, and retrieving dictionaries based on locale or ID.

methods.name: ExternalDictionaryFactory
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with context and configuration.

methods.name: getDictionaryOverrideKey
methods.description: Generates a preference key for overriding the dictionary for a specific keyboard.

methods.name: isOverrideDictionaryPrefKey
methods.description: Checks if a given preference key is an override dictionary key.

methods.name: clearAddOnList
methods.description: Clears the list of add-ons and internal mappings.

methods.name: loadAddOns
methods.description: Loads all available add-ons and populates internal mappings.

methods.name: getDictionaryBuilderByLocale
methods.description: Retrieves a dictionary add-on builder for a specific locale.

methods.name: isAddOnEnabledByDefault
methods.description: Indicates whether an add-on is enabled by default.

methods.name: isAddOnEnabled
methods.description: Checks if an add-on is enabled.

methods.name: setAddOnEnabled
methods.description: Sets the enabled state of an add-on (unsupported for dictionaries).

methods.name: createConcreteAddOn
methods.description: Creates a new dictionary add-on based on provided attributes.

methods.name: getBuildersForKeyboard
methods.description: Retrieves the list of dictionary builders associated with a specific keyboard.

methods.name: setBuildersForKeyboard
methods.description: Associates a list of dictionary builders with a specific keyboard.

methods.name: getLocalesFromDictionaryAddOns
methods.description: Returns an iterable of distinct locales from all dictionary add-ons.
